Yohane Osuboni asɛnka
(Marko 1.1-8; Luka 3.1-18; Yohane 1.19-28)
1 # Luk 1.13 Na nna no mu no, Yohane a ɔyɛ osuboni no ba bɛkaa asɛm wɔ Yudea serɛ so 2#Mat 4.17 sɛ: Monsakyera mo adwene; na ɔsoro ahennie no abɛn. 3#Yes 40.3; Yoh 1.23 Na oyi ne deɛ Odiyifoɔ Yesaia kaa ne ho asɛm sɛ:
Obi nne reteam wɔ ɛserɛ so sɛ:
Monsiesie Awurade kwan!
Momma n’atempɔn ntene!
4 # 2 Ah 1.8 Nso na Yohane yi fira ntoma a wɔde yoma nwi na ayɛ, na nwoma abɔsoɔ bɔ n’asene, na n’aduane ne ntutummɛ ne wiram woɔ. 5Ɛnna Yerusalemfoɔ ne Yudeafoɔ nyinaa ne Yordan ho asase nyinaa sofoɔ firi kɔɔ ne nkyɛn; 6na wɔkaa wɔn bɔne maa no bɔɔ wɔn asu wɔ Asubɔnten Yordan mu.
7 # Mat 23.33 Na Yohane hunuu Farisifoɔ ne Sadukifoɔ no mu bebree sɛ wɔreba asubɔ no ho no, ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Nhuritia mma! Hwan na ɔkyerɛɛ mo sɛ monnwane mfiri abufuo a ɛreba no ho? 8Ɛnneɛ monso aba a ɛkyerɛ adwensakyera. 9#Rom 2.28-29; 4.12; Yoh 8.33; 8.39 Na monnsusu nnka no mo mu sɛ: Yɛn agya ne Abraham; na mereka makyerɛ mo sɛ: Onyankopɔn bɛtumi anyane mma afiri aboɔ yi mu ama Abraham. 10#Luk 13.7-9 Nanso wɔde akuma no ato nnua no nhini ho dada; enti dua biara a ɛnso aba pa no, wɔbɛtwa ato ogya mu.
11 # Yoh 1.26-27; 1.33; Aso 1.5 Me deɛ, mebɔ mo asu wɔ nsuo mu kɔ adwensakyera mu, na deɛ ɔdi m’akyi reba no deɛ, ɔkorɔn kyɛn me; na ne mpaboa mpo, mensɛ sɛ mekura. Ɔno na ɔbɛbɔ mo asu Honhom Kronkron ne ogya mu. 12#Mat 13.30 Ɔno na ne nhusoɔ apaawa kuta ne nsam, na ɔbɛpra aporoeɛ hɔ fitaa. Ɔbɛboaboa n’ayuo ano akɔgu san so, na ntɛtɛ no deɛ, ɔde ogya a ɛnnum da bɛhye.
Yesu asubɔ
(Marko 1.9-11; Luka 3.21-22; Yohane 1.31-34)
13Ɛnna Yesu firi Galilea baa Yordan ho, Yohane nkyɛn sɛ ɔmmɔ no asu. 14Na ɔno deɛ, ɔsii no kwan sɛ: Me mmom a ɛhia me sɛ wobɔ me asu no na woreba me nkyɛn yi? 15Na Yesu bua see no sɛ: Seesei deɛ, ma ho kwan; na ɛnam yei so na yɛhyɛ tenenee nyinaa ma. Ɛnna ɔmaa no kwan. 16Na wɔbɔɔ Yesu asu wieeɛ no, ɔfirii nsuo no mu, hwɛ, ntɛm ara na ɔsoro bue maa no, na ɔhunuu Nyankopɔn Honhom sɛ ɛresiane sɛ aburuburo ba ne soɔ. 17#Mat 17.5; Yes 42.1 Na hwɛ, ɛnne bi firi soro kaa sɛ: Oyi ne me Dɔba a ɔsɔ m’ani.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na nna no mu no, Yohane a ɔyɛ osuboni no ba bɛkaa asɛm wɔ Yudea serɛ so sɛ: Monsakyera mo adwene; na ɔsoro ahennie no abɛn. Na oyi ne deɛ Odiyifoɔ Yesaia kaa ne ho asɛm sɛ:
Obi nne reteam wɔ ɛserɛ so sɛ:
Monsiesie Awurade kwan!
Momma n’atempɔn ntene!
Nso na Yohane yi fira ntoma a wɔde yoma nwi na ayɛ, na nwoma abɔsoɔ bɔ n’asene, na n’aduane ne ntutummɛ ne wiram woɔ. Ɛnna Yerusalemfoɔ ne Yudeafoɔ nyinaa ne Yordan ho asase nyinaa sofoɔ firi kɔɔ ne nkyɛn; na wɔkaa wɔn bɔne maa no bɔɔ wɔn asu wɔ Asubɔnten Yordan mu.
Na Yohane hunuu Farisifoɔ ne Sadukifoɔ no mu bebree sɛ wɔreba asubɔ no ho no, ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Nhuritia mma! Hwan na ɔkyerɛɛ mo sɛ monnwane mfiri abufuo a ɛreba no ho? Ɛnneɛ monso aba a ɛkyerɛ adwensakyera. Na monnsusu nnka no mo mu sɛ: Yɛn agya ne Abraham; na mereka makyerɛ mo sɛ: Onyankopɔn bɛtumi anyane mma afiri aboɔ yi mu ama Abraham. Nanso wɔde akuma no ato nnua no nhini ho dada; enti dua biara a ɛnso aba pa no, wɔbɛtwa ato ogya mu.
Me deɛ, mebɔ mo asu wɔ nsuo mu kɔ adwensakyera mu, na deɛ ɔdi m’akyi reba no deɛ, ɔkorɔn kyɛn me; na ne mpaboa mpo, mensɛ sɛ mekura. Ɔno na ɔbɛbɔ mo asu Honhom Kronkron ne ogya mu. Ɔno na ne nhusoɔ apaawa kuta ne nsam, na ɔbɛpra aporoeɛ hɔ fitaa. Ɔbɛboaboa n’ayuo ano akɔgu san so, na ntɛtɛ no deɛ, ɔde ogya a ɛnnum da bɛhye.


Ɛnna Yesu firi Galilea baa Yordan ho, Yohane nkyɛn sɛ ɔmmɔ no asu. Na ɔno deɛ, ɔsii no kwan sɛ: Me mmom a ɛhia me sɛ wobɔ me asu no na woreba me nkyɛn yi? Na Yesu bua see no sɛ: Seesei deɛ, ma ho kwan; na ɛnam yei so na yɛhyɛ tenenee nyinaa ma. Ɛnna ɔmaa no kwan. Na wɔbɔɔ Yesu asu wieeɛ no, ɔfirii nsuo no mu, hwɛ, ntɛm ara na ɔsoro bue maa no, na ɔhunuu Nyankopɔn Honhom sɛ ɛresiane sɛ aburuburo ba ne soɔ. Na hwɛ, ɛnne bi firi soro kaa sɛ: Oyi ne me Dɔba a ɔsɔ m’ani.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
